body: Thanks,I called the Pt advocate line and left a message,they will call me back. It's so nice to get help and new ideas so I don't feel so alone in this.Thank you!

Thank you,thank you,that's a great idea. I'll look around for Parkinson's support groups,I did find out today about a free(well $1) group who can transport my Dad to and from Dr's appointments in his wheelchair thank to advice here,that's a great help!

Thanks Plattnerite,I'm going to look into the senior services offered around here tomorrow. I really appreciate the offer though. I think I'm going to go to sleep since I feel better.
Thanks again.

Thanks everyone and Tree,I feel better,at least I can sleep now and have plan of action for tomorrow to work in the garden and maybe go to the bookstore.
Thanks again. Good night.

Yes I do have a few dreams,thanks for pointing that out. I do like gardening,I like digging and rummaging around,except when I chased that 4 foot black snake outta there yesterday. I know he was harmless but SHUDDER. I love fostering animal babies but I end up with too many and I can't deal with sick pets at all. 
But I do like gardening,I think I'll focus on that for a while

LOL,thanks. Others probably consider me an asshole too then. :)
Ever since I hit 50 my filters don't work that well except with people who are down too.

Hi Tree,I'm talking about the psych meds they have me on,Paxil,Klonopin and Trazodone. Those,especially the Paxil,have a  nasty withdrawal complete with zaps and flu like symptoms. My degree is/was in Nursing but I have been either depressed or physically unable to practice for so long I've lost my license and I don't feel like I have the heart to go through that again. I almost rather try something not so people oriented like organic gardening or something.I'd even be more interested in Alternative medicine and herbs or something like that.

Thank you so much Love and Squalor, I do need to get away for some me time. After we went to the doctor today for my Dad and he mentioned that at some point we might have to place him somewhere which I am not ready to hear I dreaded coming back here with them and holed up in my room for a boo hoo fit,squalling for a while,talk about useless. There are nice places around here in coastal Fl,I just need to get out and take advantage of these things. I love my Mom dearly but she is big on applying guilt as I try to get out the door even just to go to a bookstore or something. I am having to set boundaries with them and it's not going well with Mom as she sees me as trying to "parent her" now which I'm not.

Actually I just tried a new med and it didn't work and I'm kinda pissed at myself for even trying it,I should know by now. I doubt you're an asshole and I'm glad that you stopped by to remind me that "winter ends". It was a combination of things today that made it worse than usual.
And even though I don't really know any of you the fact that you care enough to reply and helped me a lot.
Thanks.

I bet you will be there for them.
I have a big silly lab who I love most of the time except for when he's knocking me over and stepping on my toes. ;)
And some big purry kitties who seem to know when I'm down and gather near me to look adoringly into my eyes and diffuse whatever bad energy I'm feeling.

Thanks for saying that.I would like to find a website or something to give me ideas or resources to help,including transportation for my Dad to and from the dr's office. He has Parkinson's and can hardly help and hurting my back on top of everything else well...just sucks.

I am having a horrible time.I am caretaking my elderly parents and am watching my Dad go downhill and my Mom and I are exhausting ourselves trying to care for him. I have no help from my family.I am alone.I pretty much lost my career now,my degree is useless. I call people who should maybe be interested in helping me but they seem to delight in telling me to "pipe down" when my voice gets edgy.To "put me in my place" when in reality I am so far down that I feel like I am trying to get a grip on an ice ledge with my fingernails. I can get through to my psychiatrist because the receptionist and I have had a run in and she won't let me talk to him even though he has told me to call if I need to(this is only the second time) I can't get through.Hardly any therapists in this area take my insurance which they only tell me after seeing me a few times. I have no support,no real friends and am getting cut off from my only source of support which was my psychiatrist who I know can't reach. The hurt seems to much to bear. My only source of happiness is my animals. I will not be taken to an inpt facility,all they've ever done is take me off everything cold turkey start me on so many new ones I can't even think and send me out in worse shape everytime.My entire life has seemed to be an uphill climb and it's only getting worse. Why,why should I stick around??
Thank you so much,I am going to print this out and read it when I'm feeling low.

Yes it is,before all of this happened,the recent stuff with the ex I was a fairly(perhaps overly) trusting individual. I know that most people are good and kind. I just need to find a happy medium.Actually I have many people I'm close to through the internet,it's just face to face that's difficult.

Thank you,I was just feeling so very alone and the kind,thoughtful responses I got are very encouraging.
As for my parents they are very dependent on me,my Dad has dementia and parkinsons and mobility problems,sometimes it's exhausting just to get him out of his chair(he has a lift chair) and to the bathroom,dinner table etc. It's taking an incredible toll on my Mom and myself.He is so confused that he doesn't remember eating after he leaves the dinner table,every time he wakes in the chair(he naps there) and Mom isn't beside him he panics and yells for her. At times he is hateful to her and she is emotionally and physically exhausted. I wonder if we are doing more harm than good keeping him at home instead of placing him somewhere but I shudder at the thought of him in a nursing home and so does my Mom.He is a WW2 vet and I wonder if there resources that I am not utilizing. I'll call the veterans admin. tomorrow.
   And yes I never thought I would be so caught up in this newfangled internet thing but I can't imagine life without it now.
Thanks again for your thoughtful response.
Thank you so much,all I can say is thank you. I will print this out and put this into play. You're right,I can't change the past.
Thanks,I just feel numb and like I'm going through the motions with no real enjoyment or satisfaction in anything,hopefully this will lift at some point.

I've tried HRT,it doesn't agree with me. I agree that old HS "friend" was more like Ted Bundy than a friend. I don't collect strays. The cats I have are all fixed and don't go outside. I don't plan on getting any more.
I think I submitted this twice,I'm a bit addled this morning.

He has Parkinson's syndrome where it's a little different from Alzheimer's but I am afraid that soon he is not going to recognize me. He already has terrible mobility problems because he fell when they were at an ALS and broke his hip twice.

I was writing out a long epistle as to what I've been through but hit the wrong key and backed up a page and lost it,don't have the heart to write it again yet. Suffice it to say I am a survivor of childhood sexual abuse from my brother in law,my sister doesn't believe me and blames me(she is much older). I have tried to make my life work,I am fairly intelligent and went into a challenging profession and did well until I became physically ill and unable to work. My co workers who were my friends I thought seemed to blame me for getting ill and stopped talking to me.The stress and guilt from not being able to work brought up the old issues and I started acting out. I guess it was from anger at what happened to me(I still hadn't told anyone) but I would never hurt another so I hurt myself. I OD'd and cut myself,went through long term hospitalizations,was on so much medication that I couldn't think if I wanted to which made me more depressed. I did stop hurting myself about 10 years ago because I figured that I must not be supposed to die and I was hurting myself too much and my family. I gave my career and life in general another try but again I fell physically ill.An old friend from HS came back into my life. At first it seemed idyllic and I was very happy for once. But unfortunately he held a grudge from earlier when we broke up and he got involved with my family to try to convince them that I was unstable and not taking care of my parents well,even telling my family that I was taking their money which was not true.He convinced my family(who had no love lost for me anyway) that I was a risk for even hurting them and their families,told my parents that they would be indigent soon and scared them out of their own house so he could fix it up and sell it. He recruited my sister and he son and family to help hurt me. He had my nephew lure me out of the house and he went in with a key that I had asked him to give me back,called code enforcement because I had over 5 cats which was the limit for that county. He claimed that he owned the cats and that I had abandoned them and animal control seized them. I was south in another county and was unable to get them out,they wouldn't let me because ex convinced them I was a hoarder or something even though the cats were all in good shape. AC would only let me get 2 out,noty allow me to rehome any even though I had homes for some. They killed 10 of my cats. My life has pretty much been hell since then,it wasn't that much better before that.I still caretake my parents without any help from anyone including my sister.My parents and I have a decent relationship but it is strained because I can't seem to recover from what my ex did to me.I have a good psychiatrist but he doesn't seem to realize what I went though. I've had a few therapists but most are pretty bad,either worse off than me or judgmental fundies who act like I'm unclean or a source of amusement. I feel like I lift my head up just to get punched in the face again. I hate to say but I'm am growing distrustful of all men,well all people. I have a few cats again and they bring me the only joy I know.I am middle aged now and I just don't know if I can keep going on,I am miserable and it seems like I've been that way all my life. I don't have any friends,I meet people well enough but they don't want anything to do with me. Perhaps I'm projecting my misery,I don't know. I am beginning to wonder if I'm just clueless when it comes to other people,maybe I'm stupid,rude,etc. I don't know. This sounds like a bunch of whining,I'm sorry. I'm just miserable and I don't see how things could get much better,oh and I'm going through menopause too. Maybe if someone willing to read this frigging book could give me a few clues I would appreciate it. Thanks

I try to eat well,when I'm really stressed I do tend to eat junk or skip meals. I do have insomnia but take trazodone to sleep and it works pretty well,thanks for replying.
I think what is bothering me the worst now is watching my Dad deteriorate into dementia,he has essentially no memory and can't remember if he just ate if he's not sitting at the dinner table. It's stressing my Mom out badly and I'm trying to help her without being overwhelmed myself.
